name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.pointsOver_nonempty_of_long_gap
summary: From the point y over c (E^s kills at i) build f(E)·y with f monic of degree N and the standard exponents up to g below level l; the frame theorem writes p^{4δ}f(E)y through vectors invariant modulo t^A; the coefficient of E^N of this expansion (coeff_mem_constantsModE), corrected by a lift from the cokernel killer at σ^{−l}(i), is the point.

steps.claim: A point y over c at i with exponents and depth raisedAtE(−s) (pointsOver_nonempty_of_killsCokernel with hz).
steps.lean: have ⟨y, hy, F, H, _⟩ := pointsOver_nonempty_of_killsCokernel hz c

steps.claim: There is a monic f ∈ ℤ[X] of degree N with f(E)·y ∈ withExponents(i, (a, u) ↦ (g if a < l else 0) − u); by induction on l:
steps.lean:
have ⟨f, hf, H⟩ : ∃ f : ℤ[X], f.IsMonicOfDegree N ∧ aeval k.E f • y ∈ withExponents i fun a ↦
    (ite (a < l) g 0 - ·) := hN ▸ l.rec ⟨_, isMonicOfDegree_X_pow .., by
    simpa [frobEUnit_pow_smul] using! frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 s H⟩ fun l ⟨f, hf, H⟩ ↦ ⟨_,
    Eq.subst (by grind [sum_range_succ]) (((((isMonicOfDegree_X_sub_one ↑p).pow (p ^ l)).add_right
    (q := p) (by simp [NeZero.pos])).pow g).mul hf), by simpa [frobEUnit_pow_smul, frobE_eq,
    phi_pow_smul_z, hk.1, mul_smul] using! frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents l g H⟩
steps.typed_fact:
∃ f : ℤ[X], f.IsMonicOfDegree N ∧ aeval k.E f • y ∈ withExponents i fun a ↦
    (ite (a < l) g 0 - ·)

steps.claim: l = 0 (N = s): f = X^s, and E^s·y has exponent −u at E (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 s);
steps.lean:
hN ▸ l.rec ⟨_, isMonicOfDegree_X_pow .., by
    simpa [frobEUnit_pow_smul] using! frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 s H⟩

steps.claim: l → l + 1: multiply by φ^l(E)^g, which as a polynomial in E (E = z + p, φ^l(z) = z^{p^l}) is ((X − p)^{p^l} + p)^g, monic of degree g·p^l; it raises the exponent at a = l by g (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents l g).
steps.lean:
fun l ⟨f, hf, H⟩ ↦ ⟨_,
    Eq.subst (by grind [sum_range_succ]) (((((isMonicOfDegree_X_sub_one ↑p).pow (p ^ l)).add_right
    (q := p) (by simp [NeZero.pos])).pow g).mul hf), by simpa [frobEUnit_pow_smul, frobE_eq,
    phi_pow_smul_z, hk.1, mul_smul] using! frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents l g H⟩

steps.claim: By the frame theorem (spanning of φ^l(M) with 3e ≤ p^l, eA ≤ p^lδ): p^{4δ}·f(E)y = Σ_j r_j v_j with r_j ∈ S and v_j ∈ valueFieldPoints(frobKisinAinf(l)) invariant modulo t^A (E).
steps.lean:
have ⟨_, r, v, E⟩ := mem_span_set'.1 (frame_theorem.1.2.1 l A δ hq hδ _
    ⟨(mem_withExponents_stdExponent_iff.1 (mem_withExponents_of_le H)).1, (smul_mem _ _ hy).2⟩)

steps.claim: Project to the letter i: p^{4δ}f(E)y = Σ_j r_j letterProj(v_j) (y is at i).
steps.lean: apply_fun letterProj i at E; simp [mem_letterPart_iff_letterProj.1 H.1.2] at E

steps.claim: Write every s ∈ S as w(s) + E·t(s) with w(s) ∈ Λ (unramified; exists_dvd_sub_sum_z_pow at a = 0).
steps.lean:
choose w t et using
    (by simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using k.exists_dvd_sub_sum_z_pow 0 (by simp [hk.2] : _ = 1) ·)

steps.claim: Apply coeff_mem_constantsModE at n = N twice: in the extension, with the letterProj(v_j) ∈ constantsModE (letterProj_mem_constantsModE) and c = 0: d = Σ_j w(t^N r_j)letterProj(v_j) ∈ constantsModE with exponents (b, d, d₁); and in C, with the images under projTriv and c = constantAt(c), f replaced by p^{4δ}f: d' = projTriv(d) − p^{4δ}·constantAt(c) ∈ constantsModE with exponents d₂ (f is monic of degree N).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨⟨b, d⟩, d₁⟩, a, d₂⟩ := coeff_mem_constantsModE hl et
    (letterProj_mem_constantsModE hl i <| v · |>.2) (ZeroMemClass.zero_mem _) N r 0
    (min_le_left _ <| g - ·) (by simpa [E] using nsmul_mem (mem_withExponents_of_le H) _),
    coeff_mem_constantsModE hl et (letterProj_mem_constantsModE hl i <| v · |>.2.imp (.imp
    S.projTriv.wittMap_mem_frobKisinAinf fun H _ ↦ H _ ∘ S.projTriv.comp_wittMap_mem_forms) fun H
    _ ↦ H _ ∘ S.projTriv.comp_wittMap_mem_forms) ⟨constantAt_mem_locLetterPart c,
    (by simp [k.galMonoid.smul_def, constantAt, gal_smul_letterProj ·])⟩ N r (p ^ (4 * δ) •
    f) (fun _ ↦ le_rfl) (by simp [by simpa using congr(S.projTriv.wittMap $E), F, -nsmul_eq_mul])

steps.claim: Lift E^{−A}·d': p^κ ∈ liftIdeal(S, 0, l, i) (hK moved by φ^l, phi_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff), so exists_lift_of_mem_liftIdeal gives v ∈ locLetterPart(extLattice(S), l, i) (hv, n) with projTriv(v) = p^κ·E^{−A}·d' (q).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨v, ⟨hv, n⟩, q⟩ := (exists_lift_of_mem_liftIdeal (f :=
    p ^ κ) (by simpa using (phi_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff l).2 hK)).choose_spec _
    ⟨frobEUnit_zpow_smul_mem_kisinLoc.2 a.1.1,
    frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 (-A) d₂ (by clear * - hA; grind)⟩

steps.claim: The point is p^κ·d − E^A·v: it lies in kisinLoc; its image is p^κ(projTriv(d) − d') = p^{κ+4δ}·constantAt(c); its exponents are shiftedStd(l, min(A, −u − N)) (from d₁ and from v raised by A at E, frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 A); and its depth is shiftedStd(l, A) (d and smul_sub_mem_withExponents).
steps.lean:
exact ⟨_, sub_mem (nsmul_mem b.1 (p ^ κ)) (frobEUnit_zpow_smul_mem_kisinLoc.2 hv), by
    simp [q, smul_comm (_ ^ A), ← hf.1, hf.2, -nsmul_eq_mul]; module, sub_mem (nsmul_mem
    (mem_withExponents_of_le d₁ (by clear * - hA; grind)) _)
    (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 _ n),
    sub_mem (nsmul_mem d _) (smul_sub_mem_withExponents (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 A n))⟩
